phase_A.goal: 双臂从供料位中心吸附，抬高越过前墙，放到前墙内 landing 位

phase_B1.goal: 左臂从 cube 前侧面中心沿 +Y 推到后墙

phase_B2.goal: 左臂持续沿 +Y 压向后墙，右臂沿 -X 推到左墙

phase_B_exit.goal: 确认释放且 cube 静止后再回撤双臂

scope: W760 300mm walls, measured lower rear row, five sequential lower front boxes, five upper rear boxes

attachment_parameters.model_scope: Four-cup pressure-area capacity; scalar torque uses the weak bending lever. Resultant force is additionally capped at the 30 N arm acceptance limit. Isotropic D6 shear and pressure difference are uncalibrated simulation assumptions.

target_sources: fresh RGB ArUco on calibrated support planes
same-step joint encoders and flange-to-TCP calibration
wrist F/T confirmed contact and encoder propagation
control_input_boundary.cube_truth: reference publisher, event logs and stopped-state diagnostics only
control_input_boundary.pose_loss: fresh observation required at phase transitions; missing detections stop acquisition

remaining_model_assumptions: Known Cube dimensions and surveyed static wall/support geometry
Planar yaw-only resting pose on a calibrated support plane
One breakable central vacuum constraint represents each four-cup array
Last observed yaw propagates through occlusion; force and FK alone do not measure slip yaw
Ideal joint encoders and noiseless simulated wrist wrench
Simulator model gravity compensation and commanded rail base motion
Physical contact callbacks provide independent collision safety stops

vision.fallback_reason: Isaac Sim 4.5 D455 USD color prim carries unsupported cameraProjectionType metadata; capture uses a pinhole camera with the D455 color intrinsics

metadata.ground_truth_source: Isaac Sim PhysX Cube.get_world_pose at exposure time
metadata.camera_source: RGB + ArUco + solvePnP + fixed camera calibration only
metadata.control_state_source: RGB, encoder FK and wrist F/T
metadata.pairing: nearest 120 Hz reference within half a physics step; duplicate images excluded

physics_solver.reason: PhysX5.3+ TGS compatibility: official32/16 excess velocity iterations become44/4.

joint_drive_model.scope: seven arm joints with original effort limits retained
joint_drive_model.assumption: uncalibrated simulation contact compliance with original gains for A transport

trajectory_cache.fallback_reason: legacy trajectory targets predate sensor-based localization
